title: repro run --dry-run says its cap leaves out line assumes --area-usd per area
goal: repro run --dry-run's 'cap leaves out' line says it counts each remaining area at --area-usd, a worst case, so an instance that spends less per area is not read as starting fewer areas than it will

run:
import io,json,os,sys,tempfile;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import bench_repro as b
from pathlib import Path
r=Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())
ins=[{'n':n,'bare':str(r/f'o{n}.git'),'clone':str(r/f'c{n}'),'mcp_config':str(r/f'm{n}.json'),'lock_dir':str(r/f'l{n}')} for n in (1,2,3)]
(r/'instances.json').write_text(json.dumps({'rev':'','source':'x','instances':ins}))
o=[];b.run(count=3,root=r,dry_run=True,out=o.append)
l=[x for x in o if 'cap leaves out' in x];print(l[:1]);sys.exit(0 if l and all('--area-usd' in x for x in l) else 1)

notes: Review gap of SP-ysuvdxsn, rated S3 by the sprint's reviewer.
